title: Salty Dogs Jet Ski Rentals
specs: Explore calm waters of Santa Rosa Sound and iconic Crab Island sandbar
Spot dolphins and explore secluded islands and sandbars
Operator must hold or obtain a Florida boating certificate before departure; certificate available online for $14.53
No one under 18 may rent or operate the jet ski
Driver must have a physical copy of a government issued photo ID such as driver's license or passport
Operators must hold a boater's license or complete an approved boating safety course online prior to arrival; temporary certificate costs $13.95
Drivers cannot switch during rental; only one designated driver allowed
Children as young as 3 years old may ride as passengers but not in front of the driver; must be seated in the middle
Each jet ski fits up to 3 passengers at one flat rate; guides have final say on passenger arrangements due to weight limits and stability
includes: Professional safety briefing and riding demonstration before departure
Local hotspot map with personal recommendations for self-guided rentals
gap: Exact weight limit per jet ski not stated
blurb: Guests can rent self-guided jet skis to explore at their own pace within set boundaries or join a 2-hour guided jet ski tour led by a private guide through calm waters and iconic spots like Crab Island. Each jet ski fits up to 3 passengers at one flat rate, with safety briefings and equipment checks before launch.
extraNote: Cancellation allowed up to 24 hours before tour start; trip protection available for an additional fee to allow cancellation within 24 hours with refund minus protection fee · Tours cancelled in event of small craft advisory; operator discretion on safety in given conditions · No picking up additional passengers; all passengers must have waiver and wear life vest · Starting from our dock in Fort Walton Beach
